FN-3PQNFVV-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 380
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 04/01/2026
Senate Bill 380 as introduced would provide a one-time lump-sum longevity bonus of $1 per
month for each year of service to retirees of the Teachers Retirement System (TRS) whose
effective date of retirement is prior to May 1, 2026, or their beneficiaries to be paid in October
2026. According to the actuary for the Retirement System of Alabama (RSA), the cost to fund
these lump-sum payments is an estimated $32.9 million in Fiscal Year 2027, which would be
funded by an appropriation made in HB238 of the 2026 Regular Session.
